Scottsdale to downtown Prescott

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Downtown Prescott (86301) is Arizona's original territorial capital, featuring the iconic Courthouse Plaza, legendary Whiskey Row, and one of the West's best-preserved historic downtowns. At 5,300 feet elevation, Prescott offers a cool mountain escape with Victorian architecture, craft breweries, antique shops, and surrounding pine forests. Our transportation from Phoenix connects travelers to this charming Western town.

A trip to Downtown Prescott is priced on the Phoenix to Prescott private shuttle page, per vehicle from the published hourly rates.

Neighborhood guide

Downtown Prescott centers on the historic Yavapai County Courthouse and its surrounding plaza, the heart of community life since 1864. Whiskey Row along Montezuma Street earned its name from the saloons and hotels that once lined the block—today featuring restaurants, bars, and shops. Gurley Street offers boutique shopping and galleries. The surrounding neighborhoods feature Victorian homes and tree-lined streets unique in Arizona. Prescott National Forest provides hiking, and Watson Lake offers stunning granite boulder landscapes.

Getting there from Scottsdale

A day run northwest from Scottsdale, booked by the hour

Prescott is the shortest of the out-of-town runs, which is why it works as a single day. The last stretch climbs and winds, and Whiskey Row is exactly the afternoon nobody should drive home from, so most groups hold the vehicle from pickup through the ride back.

Frequently asked questions

How far is Prescott from Phoenix?

Prescott is approximately 100 miles north of Phoenix via I-17 and Highway 69. Our comfortable transportation makes the scenic journey through Arizona's Transition Zone enjoyable.

Do you offer historic downtown tours from Phoenix?

Yes! Our Prescott day trips include time to explore the historic saloon row, the courthouse square, and downtown shops. We can arrange brewery and restaurant stops for a taste of Prescott's spirited history.

Is Prescott good for a day trip from Phoenix?

Absolutely! Prescott makes an excellent day trip with its cooler climate, historic charm, and varied activities. You can explore downtown, hike the Dells, visit Watson Lake, and enjoy local dining all in one day.

Do you provide transportation to Prescott events?

We offer transportation to Prescott's many events including the World's Oldest Rodeo, Frontier Days, and holiday celebrations on Courthouse Plaza.
